research_question: Does separating coarse action structure from source appearance reduce proxy-look transfer while retaining utensil-food geometry?

rules: All three arms use identical prompt, negative prompt, seed, edit mask, VACE scale, frame count, steps and final compositor.
No output-dependent retry, seed replacement, extra repair or arm-specific prompt.
Raw and composited outputs are reviewed separately.
The third arm intentionally adds one frozen payload reference; improvement cannot be attributed to structure separation alone.
The structure scribble is a diagnostic supported-control representation, not a learned source-contact condition.
Two development cases and one seed cannot establish superiority or generalization.

claim_limit: Failure-localization diagnostic only. A positive result motivates a larger matched study; it does not prove 3D superiority, physical correctness, source conservation or publication-level effectiveness.
